_comment: The game's sounds: where each comes from, and how it is made. Run python3 tools/process-sounds.py. Every entry names its source and licence (CC0 needs no credit; CC-BY does, and goes on the credits screen). The ElevenLabs sounds in tools/sfx-prompts.json are added by the tool with defaults (loops quieter, one-shots to -2 dBFS).

naval-battle-set.title: Tiny Naval Battle Sounds Set (version 2)
naval-battle-set.author: Iwan Gabovitch (qubodup)
naval-battle-set.note: Made from US military and other public-domain recordings; the metal explosions are from freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/67474.

elevenlabs.title: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs (text to sound effects, model eleven_text_to_sound_v2)
elevenlabs.author: generated with ElevenLabs from the prompts in tools/sfx-prompts.json
elevenlabs.licence: ElevenLabs terms of service (generated audio; whether commercial use is allowed depends on the plan the sounds were made under)
elevenlabs.note: Made where there is no free real recording: the heavy guns, shell whistles, armour hits, engines and the sea, fire, alarms.
